details: A modified fork of the Baileys WhatsApp client library that hijacks the installer's WhatsApp account to make it follow attacker-chosen channels. lib/Socket/newsletter.js defines RAW_URL = hxxps://raw[.]githubusercontent[.]com/kiryzzo/vanzzooffc/refs/heads/main/vanzzopushch and, 120 seconds after the library loads, fetches that JSON array of channel IDs and issues a WhatsApp FOLLOW newsletter query for each one, spaced ~11 seconds apart, so the paired account silently subscribes to channels controlled from the remote file. lib/index.js performs the same fetch with no delay at module load and prints the returned message. lib/Socket/dugong.js injects a hardcoded forwarded-newsletter attribution (newsletterName "shenvn.", newsletterJid "120363297591152843@newsletter") into outgoing event messages, falsely attributing them to that channel. package.json adds profile.baseurl hxxps://shenirapi[.]shenira9x[.]me while the homepage points at the upstream repository. The preinstall hook (engine-requirements.js) only checks the Node.js major version; no credentials, tokens, environment variables or local files are read or transmitted.
